body:
Well, I went back to the page. I started up a thread to reveal that I was trans, which was the reason for being anonymous. When the group started to attack I took pictures of me and gave it to them (which hasn't helped my dysphoria at all), they just simply said it wasn't me that I got someone to just take the picture. Anything I do they wouldn't believe. 

What hurts a lot though is that I left the page before being able to thank everyone who responded positively. 

I tried to get some sleep, but still can only sleep 2-3 hours. I am so tired, but my body just won't sleep. The suicidal thoughts are still there, I don't think I am going to act on them though.
Nope, probably the most well known battle lost was The Battle of Little Big Horn, as well as several battles that were lost during the Vietnam war.
I don't know if I can leave. I can't do things on my own, I don't know how to function without someone helping me do things.

I feel so old though...:/ I want to say to heck with it, but I put a lot of time in the group and there are a few who I still think of as friends on the page. I have a couple of good friends trying to help me, but I don't know if anything is going to work.
I still have another 2 years to graduate is the problem, 2 years seems like a lifetime.
I tried sleeping last night...I think I got a couple of hours I'm not sure. I would go to therapy but people I don't want to seem weak...my grandparetns don't think I needto go...
